text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Beautiful red petals. Make sure to 
soak up plenty of sunlight, okay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Oh? A white flower in a place like this. 
I wonder if a seed blew in from somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Such lovely leaves. And the buds are 
swollen to bursting. So small and 
precious. Ah, but—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"It always ends up hidden in the shadows, 
doesn't it? ...I only hope that your 
blooming form will catch someone's eye as 
well."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first three years I raced through with 
Curren Bouquetd'or have successfully come 
to an end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fierce battle at the Japan Cup became 
the talk of the town, but making top 
headlines above all was—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup, hailed as the match of the 
century— It was such a thrilling race, I 
still dream about it even now!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Right now is the absolute peak— There was 
a time when I thought that, too.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"No, I don't want that! I have to go 
further, much further!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It was truly a race that made me feel that 
from the bottom of my heart!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
So—please watch me! Watch Almond Eye grow 
stronger and stronger!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. No matter how many times I watch 
it, that press conference is so typically 
Ai.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(This press conference will also become 
major headlines across the media—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(You truly are forever above the clouds. A 
magnificent, blooming dahlia...)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(There was a time... when I used to chase 
after that dazzling brilliance, too.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Yearning, pursuing―― only to change 
course in the end.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Now that I've finally reached this 
point... Have I—become something, I 
wonder?)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Into something like a large, blooming 
flower, just like her—)

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Aaah, excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Curren Bouquetd'or, was it!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, you learned about me after watching 
the Japan Cup?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yes! And I watched all the previous races, 
documentaries, and read every magazine 
too!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Always single-minded, giving it more 
effort than anyone else—getting to know 
that about her—

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...I'm really not that fast. I'm near the 
bottom of the club, too.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
All I could think about was quitting. And 
yet, I just couldn't give up.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"It was during that time that I watched 
the Japan Cup. And from then on, I started 
following your career—"

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I just... I just felt like...! There was 
no way I was gonna give up!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I want to become a radiant, singular 
flower just like Bouquet-san one day, too!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —A shining, solitary flower... is it?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll work super hard on my training 
and debut in the Twinkle Series someday!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Yes. I'm sure you will do great. I'll be 
cheering for you from behind the scenes. 
Good luck.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while taking a walk with her, we 
were discussing our plans for the future.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amidst the cluster of vibrant red 
wildflowers, I spotted a tiny white 
blossom.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Yes, it is beautiful and powerful. 
Furthermore—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's a small petal, if it blooms 
with dignity, it can linger in someone's 
heart like this, can't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her speak as if projecting 
something onto her words, I found myself 
nodding deeply.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I must ensure that I continue to bloom as 
well, shouldn't I?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Just like this flower. —Bloom with all 
your might.
